The second is false of the repository. src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/AR-arkansas.json states, at line 2506, 'Sealing petition filing fee $0 Filing fees eliminated by the 2019 amendments'; at line 2505, 'Act 1460 eliminated sealing filing fees; the real costs are records and any counsel'; and at line 2484, in the filing rule, 'File in the circuit or district court that handled the case. assignments.decisiveDefect: participant-instructions.md carries none of this route's 13 committed selfHelpStopConditions, and it affirmatively contradicts one of them. The registry's first condition is an express hard stop for non-citizens - the Utah Courts self-help page itself tells non-citizens to consult an immigration lawyer before expunging, because the FBI may retain records of an expunged case - and the packet never mentions immigration, citizenship, a lawyer, an attorney or counsel anywhere in the file. The registry's second condition is that self-help ends when the prosecutor or a victim objects or the court schedules a hearing; the packet instead tells the participant 'The prosecutor or a victim in your case may object; if the court schedules a hearing, attend it', directing self-representation at the exact point the route's own record says to stop.

SELF_HELP_STOP.whatIsWrong: Zero of 13 selfHelpStopConditions and zero of 16 selfHelpBoundaries from data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json track ut_pet_conviction appear in participant-instructions.md. A keyword scan of the whole file returns 0 occurrences of 'lawyer', 'attorney', 'immigration', 'citizen' and 'counsel'. Missing in particular: the non-citizen hard stop; the objection-or-hearing stop, which is contradicted rather than merely omitted; the 77-40a-303(4) and (5) conviction-count limits that run on total criminal history across all states including previously expunged cases; the 77-40a-303(6) mixed-episode counting rule; whether an offence is a violent felony under 76-3-203.5(1)(c)(i); which of case closure, release or termination of supervision starts the waiting period; BCI offering a special certificate instead of a certificate of eligibility, which moves the eligibility decision to the court; an active protective order or stalking injunction; expunging appellate records; and the public-interest showing that has to be argued rather than simply stated - which matters here because the packet already leaves that explanation blank for the participant to write.
SELF_HELP_STOP.whereToFix: data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/ut/ut-pet-conviction-set--official-pdf-fill/participant-instructions.md, and the builder that emits it.
SELF_HELP_STOP.whatGoodLooksLike: The sibling packet in this same wave, wv_conv_multiple_misdemeanors-set, does this correctly: it carries a 'Where self-help ends' section reproducing all ten of its route's selfHelpStopConditions word for word, cites the exact file, track and field so a reader can check it, escalates the immigration item to an express hard stop, and separates the two post-filing stops with the instruction to look for a lawyer as soon as an opposition is served. The input is available and the pattern is established; this is an omission, not a blocked legal input.
SELF_HELP_STOP.evidence: legal-design-track-registry.json track ut_pet_conviction selfHelpStopConditions (13) and selfHelpBoundaries (16); participant-instructions.md line 40 and full-file keyword scan

assignments.decisiveDefect: The packet does not state where self-help ends, and in particular never states the committed track registry's first recorded self-help stop condition for pa_pardon_expungement: "The participant has not yet obtained a pardon; the pardon application itself is out of scope and is a referral."
assignments.whyItMatters: That condition is the entry condition for the whole route. A participant who has not obtained a pardon is not eligible for anything in this packet, and the packet is the only place they learn what the route needs. As built it would have them fill seventy-eight blanks, order a Pennsylvania State Police criminal history within a 60-day window, and pay a county filing fee reported at roughly $132 to $215, for a petition that cannot succeed. The build's own findings file shows the builder knew the conditional-versus-unconditional question was 'a self-help limit' and chose to state the difference in terms; the not-yet-pardoned case was not carried over at all.

registrySelfHelpStopConditions: The participant has not yet obtained a pardon; the pardon application itself is out of scope and is a referral.
Whether the pardon is conditional or unconditional cannot be determined from the document.
The record still appears after the quarterly cycle and the fallback route's availability is unclear.

statedInThePacket.condition1_notYetPardoned: NOT STATED anywhere. The five rendered pages use the word 'pardon' three times and all three are route labels: the guidance page's 'Route: Expungement Following an Unconditional Pardon' and the two printed route keys. participant-instructions.md never raises it.
statedInThePacket.condition2_conditionalVsUnconditional: APPROACHED, NOT STATED AS A STOP. Instructions item 4 says a conditional pardon 'is a different matter: it may lead to Clean Slate limited access rather than to full expungement', without saying the packet cannot determine which the participant holds or that this is a point to stop and get help.
statedInThePacket.condition3_fallbackAvailabilityUnclear: APPROACHED, NOT STATED AS A STOP. The guidance page says it states no timetable and no criterion because neither is established by the two forms the packet is built from, and directs the participant to the Clerk of Courts.

assignments.theRepair: Add a section to participant-instructions.md that states where self-help ends on this route, and state all three of the registry's recorded stop conditions in the registry's own words, the not-yet-pardoned referral first. The pattern already exists in this repository and should be followed rather than invented: data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/pa/pa-490-nonconviction-set--official-pdf-fill/participant-instructions.md carries '## Where self-help ends', and data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/ut/ut-pet-no-charges-set--official-pdf-fill/participant-instructions.md carries '## When to stop and get a lawyer' and introduces the list with 'The committed track registry records these as the points where self-help ends on this route, in its own words.' Consider carrying the same statement onto the composed process_guidance page, which is the component that already exists to tell a reader they may be in the wrong route.
assignments.sourceOfTruthForTheRepair: data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json, track pa_pardon_expungement, field selfHelpStopConditions. The words are already settled there; nothing needs to be drafted or referred to counsel.

assignments.decisiveDefect: The packet states the fee position and says nothing at all about a waiver route. The word 'waiver' does not appear in participant-instructions.md or on any of the five rendered pages.
assignments.whyItMatters: A participant who cannot pay is told neither that a waiver route may exist, nor that no committed record establishes one, nor which office would answer it. The packet already establishes for the fee that the committed records do not settle it and names the office of the court with jurisdiction as the authority; the waiver simply was not carried through the same way. The sibling family's own words for this are 'a filing you cannot pay for is a filing you cannot make.'

whatWasMeasured.feeStated: Yes. participant-instructions.md: 'Whether a filing fee applies, and how the petition must be delivered. Neither is established by the committed records this packet is built from. The office of the court with jurisdiction over the matter is the authority that can answer both — ask before you file.' The rendered instructions page carries the same in its filing step.
whatWasMeasured.waiverStated: No. Zero occurrences of 'waiver' in participant-instructions.md and zero in the extracted text of canonical.pdf. participant-instructions.md has no FEE_AND_WAIVER line, and neither its 'What this packet does not tell you' section nor any other section raises a waiver.
siblingsInTheSameJurisdictionThatDoState: composed-treatment:obligation:runtime-only:ms:uncharged-misdemeanor-immediate-dismissal-branch-99-15-59 — the other branch of this same statute — 'No committed record this packet binds states a filing fee, or a fee waiver, for this route. Ask before you go, because a filing you cannot pay for is a filing you cannot make.'

assignments.theRepair: State the waiver position alongside the fee, in the form the sibling branch already uses. The committed records this family binds — src/lib/legal-authority/routes/mississippi.json and src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/MS-mississippi.json — carry no fee term and no waiver term for this route, so the correct statement is that no committed record this packet binds states a filing fee or a fee waiver for this route, and that the office that answers both is the office of the court with jurisdiction over the matter. Carry it onto the rendered filing-instructions page as well as into participant-instructions.md, since the two must agree. Adding a FEE_AND_WAIVER line to the instructions table would also bring this family into line with both its siblings.
assignments.sourceOfTruthForTheRepair: The absence is already established and needs no new research: the route contract carries no fee or waiver term, which is why the packet can already say the fee is not established. The repair states the same absence for the waiver.
whatTheRepairMustNotDo: Do not state or imply that no fee waiver is available. The record is silent, and silence is not a finding — the packet's own handling of service is the model: 'THAT IS NOT A FINDING THAT NO SERVICE IS REQUIRED - it is the absence of a record, and this packet does not turn one into the other.'

Do not import a fee or waiver rule from § 99-19-71 or § 99-19-72. This petition is brought under § 99-15-59 and the packet is already correctly careful not to read § 99-19-71 rules across to this branch.
Do not touch the fourteen obligations that pass.
If any fixture byte moves the family needs a fresh raster acceptance, and a repaired family owes a second independent read by a lane that neither built nor repaired it.
